up: Retrieve all IC50 activity values measured in nM for compounds tested against the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL238. For each matching activity, return the following details: the compound's ChEMBL ID, the canonical SMILES string, the compound key, the assay description, the target ChEMBL ID, and the PubMed ID or DOI. Include all standard relations (e.g., '>', '<', '='). Do not add a limit to the number of rows returned.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL238'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
